GlobalVariables.StudyDescription: This file contains the metadata, events, and data for REDCap project "Longitudinal EEG Registry".
GlobalVariables.redcap:ProjectNotes: This is just a personal project to demonstrate my knowledge on REDCap using publicly available data repositories related to EEG recordings from Parkinson's disease (PD) patients.

ItemDef.Name: baseline_tremor_scale
ItemDef.redcap:FieldNote: 0 to 4 scale based on the MDS-UPDRS Part III (Section 3.15/3.16 Postural/Kinetic Tremor) and the Fahn-Tolosa-Marín (FTM) Rating Scale.

ItemDef.Name: electrode_count
ItemDef.redcap:FieldNote: Log the total number of individual recording contacts/channels across all arrays, not just the number of surgical entry incisions.

Decode.TranslatedText: ≥ 10 seizures per day, on most days

1: Slight / Mild (Infrequent or slight amplitude; < 1 cm)
2: Moderate (Obvious tremor; moderate amplitude; 1 to 2 cm)
3: Marked (Severe amplitude; 2 to 4 cm; interferes with many tasks)
4: Severe (Extreme amplitude; > 4 cm; prevents eating or writing completely)
